senses.sense_definition: A high-level programming language first developed in the 1950s for scientific, engineering, and numerical computation.

examples.text: Many legacy climate models are still written in <w>Fortran</w> because of its numerical efficiency.
The physics professor asked her students to rewrite the simulation code using <w>Fortran</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Alternative letter-case form of <w>Fortran</w>, especially used for its early versions.

examples.text: In the nineteen sixties, students typically learned <w>FORTRAN</w> on punch cards.
The archive contains historical documentation describing early <w>FORTRAN</w> programs.

traits.comment: particularly used for early forms of the language
